phases.progressCheck: Record whether you can cover progressively longer distances continuously at an easy effort, working toward 5 km without stopping.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk introduction
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Cover 1 km at an easy overall effort. Alternate about 1–2 minutes of gentle jogging with walking until you finish; walk whenever needed and do not force longer jogs.

targets.effort: Easy; jogging should feel comfortable, and you should be. .
targets.progressMeasure: Log total time, how many walk breaks you took, and the longest comfortable uninterrupted jog.

sessions.title: Repeat easy run-walk
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Cover 1 km using gentle jog intervals of about 1–2 minutes with walking recoveries. Keep the jogs comfortable; repeat the first session's pattern if that worked well.

targets.effort: Easy, conversational effort; walk before jogging feels hard.
targets.progressMeasure: Log total time, number of walk breaks, and longest comfortable uninterrupted jog; compare with October 5.

sessions.title: Comfortable run-walk
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Cover 1 km at an easy effort. Jog gently for up to about 2 minutes at a time, then walk until ready to jog again; shorter jogs are fine.

targets.effort: Easy and controlled; you should be able to speak comfortably
targets.progressMeasure: Log total time, walk breaks, and longest comfortable uninterrupted jog.

sessions.title: Repeat and keep it easy
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Cover 1 km with easy jogging and walking recoveries. Keep jog intervals at about 1–2 minutes or shorter if needed; finish feeling you could have done a little more.

targets.effort: Easy, conversational effort; no hard pushes
targets.progressMeasure: Log total time, number of walk breaks, and longest comfortable uninterrupted jog.

options.rationale: A gradual 16-week run-walk progression is a focused route that is 20% shorter than the stated 20-week steady route, while building from the reported ability to jog for about 2 minutes. Success means completing the user's goal: 5 km without stopping.
assumptions: The reported 2 minutes describes a current jog interval; overall running-session duration is not known.
Sessions use easy run-walk intervals, with duration and jogging time increasing gradually.
No running pace is assumed because the baseline gives no pace or race result.
Progress depends on how the run-walk sessions feel; the timeline is an estimate, not a guarantee.

phases.title: Establish easy run-walk sessions
phases.progressCheck: Log each session's total duration and longest comfortable continuous jog; at the end of week 4, check whether a 4-minute easy jog is manageable.

phases.title: Extend comfortable jogging
phases.progressCheck: Log the longest easy continuous jog each week; check whether 10 minutes is manageable by the end of week 8.

phases.title: Build continuous-run endurance
phases.progressCheck: Record continuous jogging time and total session distance; check whether 20 minutes of easy continuous jogging is manageable by the end of week 12.

phases.title: Work toward the full distance
phases.progressCheck: Record the longest continuous easy run; check whether 5 km can be completed without stopping, adjusting the timeline if needed.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk introduction
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Keep the jog relaxed: jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds. Use any remaining time for easy walking.

targets.effort: Easy; jogging should feel controlled and allow conversation.
targets.progressMeasure: Log total session time and whether all four 2-minute jogs felt controlled.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk repeat
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds. Keep both parts comfortable; finish with easy walking if needed.

targets.effort: Easy; stay relaxed and able to talk.
targets.progressMeasure: Log total session time and the longest jog interval completed comfortably.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk repeat
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds. Keep the effort easy rather than trying to jog faster.

targets.effort: Easy; conversational jogging with relaxed walking recoveries
targets.progressMeasure: Log whether each jog interval stayed comfortable and note any need to shorten an interval.

sessions.title: Slightly longer easy run-walk
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds. Add one relaxed 1-minute jog, then walk easily to finish.

targets.effort: Easy; conversational throughout, with no push to run faster.
targets.progressMeasure: Log total session time and whether the additional 1-minute jog felt comfortable.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk repeat
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds; add one relaxed 1-minute jog. Walk easily for any remaining time.

targets.effort: Easy; relaxed and able to talk.
targets.progressMeasure: Log the longest comfortable jog and whether the session felt similar in effort to the prior one.

sessions.title: Easy run-walk repeat
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Jog for 2 minutes, walk for 2 minutes, and repeat for 4 rounds; add one relaxed 1-minute jog. Keep the finish easy.

targets.effort: Easy; do not turn the jogs into hard efforts.
targets.progressMeasure: Log total session time and whether the planned jog intervals were completed comfortably.
